$meta.name: gr8r-studio (Tanjim, @Tanjim38, gr8r studio)
$meta.licence: repo has NO licence: study and measure only, never copy code or assets into a deliverable
$meta.stack: Vite 6 + vanilla ES modules + plain CSS, Lucide subset via a virtual:icons plugin (vite.config.js:9-48), no UI framework, no runtime deps
$meta.file_note: the token file header still says QUIRE (tokens.css:2): the system was renamed, the tokens were not
$meta.how_to_read: values are as written in source; `src` is file:line relative to source_root. Rendered checks live in knowledge/benchmarks/tanjim-x/app/computed.json

colour.model: warm-neutral greys (hue ~40-50, yellow-brown), light on bare :root, dark REDEFINED not inverted, one swappable accent, semantic hues tuned separately per theme

bg-side.note: sidebar is darker than page; main area is --surface white

surface-3.role: active/pressed fill, seg track, progress track

sunken.role: board columns, out-of-month days, group rows, weekends

divider.role: row separators inside a container (lighter than border)

semantic.soft: green 11%, amber 12%, red 10% color-mix to transparent (tokens.css:41-43)

bg-side.note: sidebar darker than page in dark too

pc-mix.note: project-icon glyph colour is mixed 72% hue + 28% text in dark so saturated hues do not buzz (shell.css:187-190)

dark.surface_step_L: bg 1a -> surface 1d -> s2 25 -> s3 2d: ~3-8 L steps, all one warm hue

accent_variants.note: each accent is a light/dark PAIR, never one value

project_colours.use: always as color-mix tints: pico 16% bg (shell.css:180), picon 14% (projects-files.css:54), cal event 11% bg + 22% border (calendar.css:82-86), timeline bar 16% bg + 45% border + 26% progress fill (timeline.css:147-169)

elevation.philosophy: one edge per box: cards are drawn by a 0 0 0 1px ring INSIDE the shadow stack, not a border; dark mode drops the drop shadows and keeps only the ring

kcard-hover.note: hover strengthens the RING, adds a 2px lift shadow

elevation.tint_shadow_hue: light shadows use rgba(28,25,20) (warm near-black) not pure black (tokens.css:51-54)

off_scale.5px: badge, lbl, seg button, cal event, tooltip, pico, skeleton (components.css:414,502,550; calendar.css:80; shell.css:177)

ladder_by_height.what: btn, ibtn, input, select, sidebar row, menu item
kanban card, attachment card, alert, comment box
panel, stats strip, board column, popover, project card, file card, bulkbar

radius.nesting: popover 10 with 4px padding -> menu item 6 (10-4=6, concentric; overlays.css:451-453, 491-493). Board column 10 with 8px body padding -> card 8 (not strictly concentric, reads fine at that size). Palette 12, 6px list padding -> item 6 (overlays.css:626,675,703).

spacing.real_usage_note: the scale is declared but most components hard-code odd values: btn pad 0 11px (components.css:11), panel-h 12px 14px 10px (panels.css:13), stat 14px 16px (panels.css:37), kcard pad 10px/12px (board.css:82), mini row 0 14px (list.css:218), nrow 11px 14px (panels.css:92). The working inset is 14px for panels and 8px for menus/rows

gutter.rule: breadcrumb, page header, toolbar, list checkbox, table first cell and board all start on var(--gutter)

gaps.src: components.css:10; shell.css:113; overlays.css:489,700; panels.css:77; projects-files.css:7; board.css:6,86,69

families.load: font stylesheet loaded with media=print then swapped (index.html:14), so the system stack shows first

scale.note: half-pixel steps (12.5, 13.5, 14.5): a dense desktop UI scale, ~1.07 ratio in the body range, ~1.2 above

roles.role: project title / settings h1 / drawer title
section h2.sec / modal title / empty-state title
body / sidebar row / menu item / task title

type.numerals: tabular-nums on stats, due dates, counts, calendar day numbers, timeline days (panels.css:61; list.css:259; shell.css:161; calendar.css:59; timeline.css:101)
type.no_bold_700_in_ui: 700 appears only on social glyph placeholders (auth.css:82)

stroke.note: not Lucide's default 2: a hair lighter so 16px glyphs match 13.5px text weight

custom_glyphs.status: 14px circles: dashed ring (backlog), ring (todo), half pie (progress), three-quarter pie (review), filled check (done), r 5.4, stroke 1.5 (ui/helpers.js:21-34)
custom_glyphs.priority: 3 rising bars 2.6 wide rx1, urgent = red 12px rounded square with ! (ui/helpers.js:35-43)
custom_glyphs.note: Linear-grammar status pies instead of coloured pills

controls.search_input_icon: absolute left 9px, input padding-left 30px, kbd right 7px (components.css:289-301)
controls.select: native select restyled as menu by ui/select.js; chevron 12px svg at right 9px (components.css:276-283, 710-736)
controls.checkbox: 15px r4 1.5px border, checked accent, tick 8x5 drawn with borders (components.css:307-344)
controls.toggle: 30x18, knob 14 white with 0 1px 2px shadow, travel 12px, knob spring .28s (components.css:350-379; motion.css:240-242)
controls.segmented: track surface-3 pad 2 gap 2 r6; button 24h 0 9px r5 12/500; on = surface + 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.08) + 1px ring (components.css:404-434)
controls.tabs: 36h, 0 10px, 12.5/500, underline 2px text colour inset 8px each side, r2; tabIn scaleX .4->1 .26s (components.css:437-493)
controls.badge: 20h 0 7px r5 12/500 surface-2 + border; tinted variants drop the border (components.css:496-543)
controls.label_chip: 20h, 6px square r2 colour swatch + text-2 on surface with border (components.css:544-562)
controls.filter_chip: 26h r6, accent-soft bg, accent-line border, 18px ibtn close (components.css:563-583)
controls.avatar: 22 default (sm 20, md 26, lg 36, xl 64), initials at 40% size 600, bg hue 17% on surface, fg hue 55% + text, 1.5px surface ring to separate stacks, stack overlap -5px (components.css:611-651)
controls.progress: 4h r4 track surface-3, fill scaleX(var(--p)) .3s ease (components.css:671-697)
controls.kbd: 18h min-w 18 mono 11 r4, border with 1.5px bottom (key-cap) (base.css:121-137)
controls.tooltip: text bg / text-inv fg, 11/500, 5px 7px, r5, 6px offset, fades in after .35s delay over .12s (components.css:162-201)
controls.focus_ring: 2px solid accent, offset 1px, r4 (base.css:72-76); inputs use the 3px soft halo instead

rows.src: list.css:17,13,109,147,134,217; table.css:21,56,96; timeline.css:42,22; overlays.css:491,701,639; calendar.css:24; projects-files.css:172

layout.topsearch: 220w 26h, sunken bg, border, kbd at right (shell.css:319-332)

breakpoints.1100: grid2 stacks, search collapses to icon

layout.home_grid: stats strip of 4 joined cells (one outer border, internal dividers), then grid2 1.55fr / 1fr, gap 16 (panels.css:29-35,74-78)

state_language.hover: fill one step up (surface -> surface-2); text-2 -> text; icons text-4 -> text-2. Never a colour change on neutral controls (components.css:73-76, shell.css:128-131)
state_language.active_pressed: fill two steps (surface-3) + scale(.97) on buttons, scale(.88) on checkboxes (components.css:28-30, 77-81; motion.css:231-233)
state_language.selected_nav: light: white surface + 1px ring + 0 1px 2px shadow, weight 500 (a raised tab). dark: surface-3 fill, NO ring or shadow (shell.css:132-149)
state_language.focus: focus-visible only: 2px accent outline offset 1 (base.css:69-76); form fields: accent border + 3px soft halo (components.css:260-266)
state_language.disabled: opacity .45 (buttons, menu items) or .4 (ibtn), pointer-events none (components.css:95-100,151-154; overlays.css:526-529)
state_language.error: red border + 3px red-soft halo + 12px red message with 12px icon (components.css:220-226,267-270)
state_language.done: text-3 + line-through; calendar chips .55 opacity; timeline bars .6 (list.css:87-91; calendar.css:96-101; timeline.css:172-174)
state_language.drop_target: 2px accent line (list.css:45-50; board.css:167-173; shell.css:212-221) or accent 6% wash + accent-line border on column (board.css:74-77)
state_language.hover_reveal: row handles, column actions, card quick actions, attachment remove and sgroup + buttons are opacity 0 / display none until hover (list.css:61-71; board.css:121-134; shell.css:102-109)
state_language.unread: accent 3.5% row wash (panels.css:98-100); 7px accent dot with 2px surface ring on the bell (shell/layout.js:197)

entrances.dur: 520ms cubic-out, skipped under 2 and under reduced motion

feedback.fx: row green wash 1s, card green 2px ring 1s, check popCheck .55->1.2->1 .42s spring, title strike drawn left-to-right .38s at 58% height
land: from scale 1.04 rotate -1.2deg + drag shadow to rest, .5s spring

motion.gating: one-shot fx flags set for the render that owns them, cleared after, so full re-renders never replay animations (shell/render.js:79-84, 186-188)
motion.reduced_motion: every entrance collapses to a .12s fade; bars and count-up skipped; strike becomes plain line-through; app-level data-motion=reduce override (motion.css:263-314)
motion.skeleton: shimmer 1.3s ease-in-out infinite, 220% gradient s3->s2->s3, r5 (states.css:39-53)
